title: Factor systems and geometric structures of strongly graded rings
summary: Graded rings provide a natural algebraic framework for encoding symmetry via decompositions into homogeneous components indexed by a group, together with multiplication rules reflecting the group operation. Among graded rings, strongly graded rings form a particularly well-behaved and structurally rich class. In this paper we introduce a notion of factor systems for strongly graded rings, consisting of algebraic data that encode both the bimodule structure of the homogeneous components and their multiplication relations.
